mainEntity.name: What are the differences between renting out a tiny home on wheels versus a foundation tiny home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Renting out a tiny home on wheels (THOW) typically faces different regulations than a foundation-built tiny home, which is usually classified as an ADU. THOWs are often considered RVs and may be restricted to RV parks or require specific permits for longer-term placement on private land. Foundation tiny homes, as ADUs, usually have clearer paths for long-term rental and are subject to traditional building codes. Understanding these distinctions is crucial for legal rental. Zen Tiny Homes specializes in foundation tiny homes suitable for ADU regulations.
